firstPlayerRule: In the two-player simple mode, whoever most recently watched a spy movie starts.
clarifications: The team variant is for three or four players and says teammates agree who plays the face-up card first during their turn; it does not separately restate the starting-team criterion.

sources.title: Agent Avenue — Nerdlab Games English rulebook
sources.location: Simple Mode: Game Setup; Team Variant: Game Setup and Game Turn

internalEvidence: The Nerdlab product page links the English rulebook. Publisher PDF page 4 explicitly names the most recent spy-film watcher as the simple-mode starting player; page 14 sets out team setup and teammate card order. Both pages were rendered and read. The base rule is limited to the identified two-player simple mode because the team variant does not restate an initial-team selection. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked rendered setup and team-variant pages.
uncertainty: The cited team-variant pages do not explicitly select an initial team; the simple-mode instruction should not be presented as a confirmed team rule.
The rulebook states no tie-break for equally recent spy-movie viewing.
